title: U-HamGNN: a universal model for magnetic Hamiltonians conditioned on spin and Hubbard U
abstract: arXiv:2611.20035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The electronic structure of a magnetic crystal depends jointly on its spin configuration and the on-site Hubbard correction U, requiring a separate DFT+U calculation for each combination. We introduce U-HamGNN, an equivariant network that takes these two inputs directly and predicts spin-resolved Hamiltonians across diverse crystal chemistries. A spectral-hybrid optimizer that weights each update direction by how consistently the gradient points along it reaches 8% lower Hamiltonian error than Muon and 26% lower than AdamW in a ten-epoch benchmark. The predicted bands reproduce U-dependent gap opening and altermagnetic spin splitting within the trained window and beyond it; exchange couplings and magnetic-order calls derived from the Hamiltonian agree with DFT+U on a calibration set. This universal model provides a new tool for magnetic research.

translated_title: U-HamGNN：以自旋和Hubbard U为条件的磁性哈密顿量通用模型
translated_abstract: 磁性晶体的电子结构同时取决于其自旋构型和在位Hubbard修正U，因此需要对每种组合单独进行DFT+U计算。我们提出了U-HamGNN，一种等变神经网络，它直接以这两个参量为输入，在多种晶体化学体系中预测自旋分辨的哈密顿量。我们设计了一种谱混合优化器，它根据每个更新方向上梯度指向的一致程度对更新方向加权，在十轮基准测试中，其哈密顿量误差比Muon低8%，比AdamW低26%。预测的能带在训练范围内及其之外均能重现随U变化的带隙开启和交变磁性自旋劈裂；由哈密顿量导出的交换耦合和磁序判断在校准集上与DFT+U结果一致。该通用模型为磁性研究提供了一种新工具。
tldr: U-HamGNN是一种以自旋构型和Hubbard U为输入的等变神经网络通用模型，可直接预测自旋分辨的磁性哈密顿量，其谱混合优化器显著降低预测误差，并能准确重现U依赖的带隙开启、交变磁性自旋劈裂及交换耦合等性质。
en_tdlr: U-HamGNN is a universal equivariant network conditioned on spin configuration and Hubbard U that directly predicts spin-resolved magnetic Hamiltonians, using a novel spectral-hybrid optimizer to achieve lower errors than Muon and AdamW while accurately reproducing U-dependent gap opening, altermagnetic spin splitting, and exchange couplings.
